findings.explanation: implementation lists a charge_pct below 80% alert, but the SPL has no such condition (charge_pct is only displayed), and the description omits the battery_status condition.
findings.quote: Alert on low charge (<80%), low runtime (<30 min), high temperature (>35°C), or abnormal status.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the charge condition to the documented logic or remove it from the implementation, and describe the battery_status test.

findings.explanation: UC-15.1.1 and UC-15.1.10 monitor the same snmp:ups feed with runtime_min and thresholds of 15 and 10 or 20 minutes; this UC uses a different field name and a 30-minute threshold with no stated reason.
findings.suggested_fix: Align field names and explain how the three UCs differ, or consolidate.

findings.explanation: The SPL uses runtime_remaining_min, battery_temp_c and battery_status, with no mapping from the MIB names. A Universal Forwarder is not an SNMP poller, and 617 is not in the cached Splunkbase catalog; the guide uses Heavy Forwarder SNMP polling and the field upsBatteryStatus with numeric values.
findings.quote: SNMP UPS-MIB (upsEstimatedMinutesRemaining, upsBatteryStatus, upsBatteryTemperature) Collected via Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617) modular input or scripted poll into the index named in the SPL.
findings.suggested_fix: Document the OID-to-field mapping and the real collector. Verify the Splunkbase ID.

findings.explanation: References are generic Splunk pages; none covers UPS batteries or RFC 1628.
findings.suggested_fix: Cite RFC 1628 and the vendor UPS MIB documentation.

findings.explanation: The scenarios are template wording with no battery-specific cause.
findings.quote: Scheduled automation elevates `src` without crossing `runtime_remaining_min` < 30 for UC-15.1.22.
findings.suggested_fix: Cite real causes: recharging after an outage or self-test, a runtime calibration run, and a warm battery cabinet briefly above 35 °C.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: `battery_status!="normal"` assumes a text value, but RFC 1628 upsBatteryStatus is numeric (2 is normal, per the guide), so every row alerts unless mapped; null status also alerts.

summary: UPS battery monitoring that overlaps UC-15.1.1 and UC-15.1.10 with a third set of thresholds and field names. The implementation promises a low charge alert the SPL does not include.
